data.name: Engineering and Technology
data.vision: Our goal is to deliver world class, solutions driven programs that inspire curiosity and generate new knowledge and discoveries. Our collaboration with over 50 of the world’s best universities and 215 corporates, strengthens our academic and research programs.
data.mission: Our mission is to seek solutions to global challenges by using the power of engineering principles, techniques and systems. We believe that engineers should not only possess deep technical excellence, but also nurture creativity, cultural awareness and entrepreneurial skills that come from exposure to science, business, medicine and other disciplines all integral part of the SRM experience.

data.vision: Our vision is to be an internationally recognized portal for the Hospitality industry by developing professionals for the future needs of the industry.

data.name: College of Occupational Therapy
data.vision:
To promote international standards of excellence and competency in academics and clinical practice in Occupational Therapy.
To enhance the health, well-being, and quality of life of individuals, populations, and communities across diverse settings.
To harness the full potential of innovation, collaboration, and advanced practices in addressing emerging healthcare challenges.
data.mission:
To provide high-quality academic and clinical education that develops competent, ethical, and skilled occupational therapy professionals capable of delivering client-centered rehabilitation services.
To create a dynamic learning environment that fosters critical thinking, research aptitude, and the application of evidence-based practice in occupational therapy.
To strengthen academic excellence by promoting advanced knowledge, innovation, and scholarly research in rehabilitation sciences.
To inculcate professional ethics, integrity, compassion, confidence, and social responsibility while promoting the welfare of individuals, communities, and the profession.
To develop leadership, advocacy, and collaborative skills that contribute to the advancement of occupational therapy and improved health outcomes for diverse populations.

data.name: Allied Health Sciences
data.vision: To be a center of excellence in allied health sciences by nurturing competent, compassionate, and globally competent healthcare professionals through innovative education, clinical excellence, research, and community engagement.
data.mission: To provide industry-integrated, patient-centered education through quality teaching, clinical training, and experiential learning while promoting excellence in research, innovation, and evidence-based healthcare. The institution is committed to developing ethical, skilled, and compassionate allied health professionals through holistic education and expert mentorship, and to strengthening healthcare through strategic collaborations, community engagement, and global partnerships.
